thread:
Lena: thinking out loud — when saving a view scoped to route+model, can we show a tiny "cost & route hint" inside the save modal? quick glance before saving would reduce support questions.
Diego: backend currently POST /api/v1/saved_view with name, filters, scope. we can add an optional routing_hint field but it must be non-breaking for old clients.
Maya (UX): users want an immediate 'estimated token burn' and a latency band indicator. tiny meter + ? tooltip. keep interactions minimal.
Ishan: architecturally, a preview endpoint makes sense: POST /api/v1/preview_saved_view -> returns estimate and latency percentiles. make sure it's cached and cheap.
Lena: idea: run preview only on explicit button or after a short idle (1s). cache keyed by filters-hash+model+route for ~10m. show cached value with a small 'stale' badge.
Diego: API shape suggestion: preview returns token_estimate and latency_p50/latency_p95 as strings to avoid client schema issues. also add saved_view.version so we can evolve the payload.
Ishan: security: routing_hint must not allow a user to target clusters outside their tenant mapping. server must validate tenant->route and drop or rewrite disallowed hints.
MetricsBot: plan: emit preview.request_count and preview.error_count. infra note: current telemetry pipeline can handle low-rate previews but recommend a sampling flag + quota to protect backend.
Maya (UX): fallback states: display 'estimate unavailable' if preview errors. include a tiny toggle 'apply saved route hint' when opening a saved view so people can opt-out during investigation.
Lena: behavior note: saved routing_hint is advisory. console should use it as the default but never silently override user routing preferences.
Diego: migration note: old saved_views stay intact. new clients may include routing_hint; document in changelog and bump client SDKs.
Ishan: implementation note: preview service should run in a sampled execution pool, redact model internals from responses, and return fast estimates (best-effort).
Maya (UX): I'll mock the modal with meter + tiny latency sparkline and a compact help tooltip, will post in #design later today.
Lena: next steps: Maya mock, Diego draft API contract + migration steps, Ishan spike preview service. reconvene Thurs. :)
